scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input contains a conflicting account of the old drive’s status: the opening says it is available “in read-only mode while people check the copied files,” but later paragraphs say groups must keep editing there during review and that read-only mode begins only after each group’s review is complete. Otherwise, the text is plausible and naturally formatted. The output is byte-identical to the input, correctly satisfying the identity requirement and preserving every paragraph, detail, qualification, and quotation.
